Prayer & Warfare

Yesterday I met a woman who is 4 years pregnant.

September 5 2 min read Latunde Akin

Yesterday I met a woman who is 4 years pregnant.
She has been carrying the pregnancy around with heavy burden.
I looked and looked at the stomach I began to weep internally.
Knowing what it takes to carry a baby for 9 months and now she's doing that since 48 months.
I tried to search and search for the cause,I discovered its purely a spiritual attack.
Today is 852nd day we have been interceding for people, I haven't come across something like this.
Yes,God is well able to deliver her,but to be sincere, I am a bit shocked to see this with my eye.
Devil doesn't have mercy on anyone. And that is why you too must be extraordinarily prepared to pray against any wrong situation around you.
Join us to pray every night at 11pm to 12am. You don't have to wait till you have emergency situation . Please try and form a habit of prayer consistency whether convenient or not. Treat God as a friend you relate with everyday in prayers and not when you need His immediate attention.
Praying at 11pm to 12am is very strategic and spiritual because,
It is a time when men sleep and when satanic men prepare to attend night meetings.
It's a time of sacrifice where God can see your consistency and help you.
It is a time you would have finished your meeting with God before they started their own meeting.
It is a time God always regard because it's not a convenient time to pray for people who has been tired from day work.
We have spent 716 days praying together at 11pm. (Intercessory is 852days) You too can join us using the link in the comment section.
We make sure we pray very well on just a prayer theme for 1 or 2 weeks, sometimes 3 weeks.
As you join us in the prayer train, may you experience a good paradigm shift.
Please also pray for the woman with 4 years pregnancy. That she would deliver safely and quickly in Jesus name. Amen.
